title: Live socket frame, capture to client
description: Designed (docs/native/capture-split.md 4.2, #773), not implemented. The JSON header of one frame capture writes on its live socket (`/run/sizeup-radio/live.sock`, a Unix stream socket; framing in contracts/capture/socket.md: `>II` header length and payload length, this JSON object, then the payload, unused in version 1). Every header has `v`, `t` and `at`; `t` says which frame it is and `$defs/<t>` lists its fields. A client skips a `t` it does not know. Live state is latest-wins and nothing is queued for an absent client: what must not be lost is in the spool or the urgent file. A `reply` frame is capture-socket-reply.schema.json.

t.description: Which frame this is. A client skips one it does not know.

at.description: When capture made the frame, Unix seconds (an `urgent` frame: when it made the item; a `status` frame: the status file's `at`).

hello.title: hello
hello.description: The first frame on every connection.

contract.description: The capture contract's major version this capture speaks, 1. Another major version: the app raises Health and does not read the spool.

impl.description: The implementation: `python`, or a native daemon's name.

started.description: When this capture process started, Unix seconds.

spool_epoch.description: The spool's epoch (its EPOCH file), 16 hex characters. A new one resets the reader's cursor.

urgent_epoch.description: The urgent file's epoch, 16 hex characters. A new one (the file was reset) starts the app's urgent cursor at 0; the set of (key, rev) it has taken still holds.

boot.description: The boot id capture's boot-clock values belong to. Opaque: compared for equality only.

snapshot.title: snapshot
snapshot.description: The whole live state: the first frame after `hello`, again after a client fell 256 frames behind and came back, and the `result` of a `snapshot` request. Latest wins.

state.description: `up`: the squelch opened. `keyed`: it has been open for the squelch's `min_open_s` (only then is it "talking"). `down`: it closed.

since.description: When the carrier came up, Unix seconds (the transmission's `start`).

continuing.description: Paging: this carrier continues the transmission before it (the continuation window).

holding.description: Closed, but the squelch still watches for the last transmission to come back (`NoiseSquelch.holding`).

quieting_db.description: How far the carrier quiets the hiss now, dB; null when not measured.

queued.description: Transmissions of this channel that closed and wait for capture's worker: not yet on the spool. A count.

talking.description: Everyone transmitting now ([] when nobody talks).

paging.description: The pages going out now, newest first ([] when none).

status_at.description: The `at` of the status file now on disk, Unix seconds.

spool_seq.description: The `seq` of the last item published to the spool; 0 for none.

carrier.title: carrier
carrier.description: A channel's squelch opened, was held open long enough to be "talking", or closed.

state.description: `up`: the squelch opened. `keyed`: it has been open for the squelch's `min_open_s` (only then is it "talking"). `down`: it closed.

since.description: When the carrier came up, Unix seconds (the transmission's `start`).

continuing.description: Paging: this carrier continues the transmission before it (the continuation window).

holding.description: Closed, but the squelch still watches for the last transmission to come back (`NoiseSquelch.holding`).

quieting_db.description: How far the carrier quiets the hiss now, dB; null when not measured.

queued.description: Transmissions of this channel that closed and wait for capture's worker: not yet on the spool. A count.

ids.title: ids
ids.description: Radio ids decoded live on an open carrier (`LiveTalk.fm_ids` from the tap).

since.description: The carrier's start, Unix seconds: which carrier the ids belong to.

ids.description: The ids decoded so far for this carrier.

urgent.title: urgent
urgent.description: An urgent item, whole: the app takes it over from the frame. The frame's `at` is the item's `at`. Sent when the item is made, and once more when a row is written for an item that was first sent with `durable` false.

urgent_epoch.description: The urgent file's epoch, 16 hex characters: `n` counts within it.

talking.title: talking
talking.description: Who is talking now, analog and P25: the whole list every time, latest wins.

entries.description: Every talker now, and whoever just finished ([] when nobody talks).

paging.title: paging
paging.description: The pages going out now: the whole list every time, latest wins.

entries.description: The pages going out now, newest first ([] when none).

ours.title: ours
ours.description: A pair of ours started ringing (`LivePaging.on_ours`): the app polls its feed adapters now.

grant.title: grant
grant.description: A unit event of another P25 system, for the app's `Activity` (unknown and encrypted talkgroups, watched counts).

src.description: The radio id, digits as a string; "" when the line has none.

what.description: The event, as trunk-recorder's unit event names it.

spool.title: spool
spool.description: An item is complete on the spool: its sidecar was renamed into items/.

ch.description: The channel's label (a call: the talkgroup's label); absent for an item with no channel (metrics).

status.title: status
status.description: The status file changed: its new `at` is the frame's `at`. Nothing else is carried; the reader reads the file.

level.title: level
level.description: A channel's levels, once a second per channel, only to a client whose hello subscribed to `level`.

quieting_db.description: How far the noise is quieted now, dB; null when not measured.

hiss_db.description: The idle hiss the quieting is measured from, relative dB; null until measured.

talker.title: One talker, raw
talker.description: One radio transmitting now, as `LiveTalk.state()` gives it, without `rig`, `label` and `main`: the app adds those from the CAD (station-state.schema.json `talker` is the decorated entry).

key.description: Stable id of this entry while it lasts: `p25:<system name>:<call key>:<radio id>` or `fm:<channel>:<since, 2 decimals>:<radio id>`.

channel.description: The talkgroup's name (P25) or the channel's label (FM).

tg.description: The P25 talkgroup number; null on an FM channel.

radio_id.description: The transmitting radio's id as decoded, digits as a string; "" when not known yet.

alias.description: The radio's over-the-air alias (P25); "" when none.

since.description: When the call or the carrier started, Unix seconds.

talk_since.description: When this radio started talking within the call, Unix seconds.

ended.description: True for a talker who just finished and is flashed until `until`.

until.description: Unix seconds until which an ended entry is still shown; null while talking.

dispatcher.description: The alias looks like a dispatch console (`LiveTalk.state()` works it out from the alias alone).

id_on_release.description: FM entries only: the carrier is open and no id was decoded yet.

page.title: One page going out, raw
page.description: A two-tone page as it is decoded, pair by pair (`LivePaging.state()`), with the contract's `a_hz` / `b_hz` (the state post to the hub says `a` / `b` today: the app maps).

started.description: When the first tone started, Unix seconds.

pairs.description: The tone pairs decoded so far, in order.

phase.description: `tones` while pairs are still coming, `voice` once the dispatcher speaks.

ended.description: The page is over; shown until `until`.

until.description: Unix seconds until which an ended page is still shown; null while it goes out.

page_id.description: The id of the finished page this became (the app's `paging_finished` notice); "" until then.
